title: Assessing Gender Bias in LLMs: Comparing LLM Outputs with Human Perceptions and Official Statistics

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with occupation-specific action sentences to predict binary gender (male/female) and comparing the models' token probabilities using Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence against human perception data, official U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics data, and a 50% neutrality benchmark.
